newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai 30 blue chips 96 earnings per share down.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai 30 blue chips 96 earnings per share down.

text.p: The 1996 average earnings per share of the 30 companies which constitute the Shanghai Stock Exchange's blue chip index was 0.51 yuan, down 16.3 percent from 1995, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.

The newspaper said the earnings/net assets ratio of 24 of the 30 firms fell in 1996. Some of the companies registered a fall in net profits in 1996 while others increased their shares outstanding, it said.
